prompt: Photorealistic full-length studio photograph of one clean-shaven man of about 30 in a 1912 dark grey three-piece wool lounge suit: a single-breasted four-button jacket, a matching waistcoat, trousers with turn-ups, a tall starched white collar, a dark silk tie, black leather boots, and a black bowler hat on his head. The whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the feet is in frame, front view, facing the camera, standing in a relaxed A-pose with the arms held a little away from the body, empty open hands, feet slightly apart and fully visible. Historically accurate 1912 Edwardian clothing and hair, a natural realistic face, sharp fabric detail.
